azureLogAnalytics.query:
uberAgent_System_SystemPerformanceSummary2_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| take [[TopN]]
| summarize AvgNetUtilizationPercent = round(avg(NetUtilizationPercent_d),1)

spec.title: CPU usage and relative frequency over time

azureLogAnalytics.query:
uberAgent_System_SystemPerformanceSummary2_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| take [[TopN]]
| summarize ["Avg. CPU usage (%)"] = round(avg(CPUUsagePercent_d),1) by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated desc

uberAgent_System_SystemPerformanceSummary2_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| summarize ["Avg. CPU relative frequency (%)"] = round(avg(CPURelativeFrequencyPercent_d),1) by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated desc

uberAgent_System_SystemPerformanceSummary2_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| summarize RAMUsagePercent = [[Function]](RAMUsagePercent_d) by Computer
| extend [[Function]]_RAMUsagePercent=round(RAMUsagePercent, 1)
| order by [[Function]]_RAMUsagePercent
| take [[TopN]]
| project Computer,[[Function]]_RAMUsagePercent

uberAgent_System_SystemPerformanceSummary2_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| summarize NetUtilizationPercent = [[Function]](NetUtilizationPercent_d) by Computer
| extend [[Function]]_NetUtilizationPercent=round(NetUtilizationPercent, 1)
| order by [[Function]]_NetUtilizationPercent
| take [[TopN]]
| project Computer, [[Function]]_NetUtilizationPercent

uberAgent_System_SystemPerformanceSummary2_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| summarize  
   ["[[Function]]. CPU (%)"] = round([[Function]](CPUUsagePercent_d),1), 
   IOPSRead = [[Function]](IOPSRead_d), 
   IOPSWrite = [[Function]](IOPSWrite_d)
   by Computer
| extend ["[[Function]]. IOPS"] = round(IOPSRead + IOPSWrite,1)
| take [[TopN]]
| project-away IOPSRead, IOPSWrite
| order by Computer asc

uberAgent_System_SystemPerformanceSummary2_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| summarize CPUUsagePercentRaw = [[Function]](CPUUsagePercent_d) by Computer
| extend [[Function]]_CPUUsagePercent = round(CPUUsagePercentRaw, 1)
| order by [[Function]]_CPUUsagePercent desc
| take [[TopN]]
| project Computer, [[Function]]_CPUUsagePercent

uberAgent_System_SystemPerformanceSummary2_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| summarize IOPercentDiskTime = [[Function]](IOPercentDiskTime_d) by Computer
| extend [[Function]]_IOPercentDiskTime=round(IOPercentDiskTime, 1)
| order by [[Function]]_IOPercentDiskTime
| take [[TopN]]
| project Computer, [[Function]]_IOPercentDiskTime

uberAgent_System_SystemPerformanceSummary2_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| take [[TopN]]
| summarize AvgCPUUsagePercent = round(avg(CPUUsagePercent_d),1)
